prompt_base: Orthographic flat front view of a single Soviet-style 1980s armoured vehicle interior panel. Even diffuse lighting, no perspective, no shadows cast from outside, no text or Cyrillic lettering, no logos. Worn grey-blue enamel steel with chipped edges and darker grime in recesses. Bolted rectangular bezel frame with countersunk screws. Hard-surface industrial and utilitarian, not sci-fi. Muted palette: grey-blue, gunmetal, cream/beige labels, signal red accents, dull olive. Small warning stripes only where stated. Photographic texture-reference quality, seamless edges inside the frame.
